work_summary: The A1.1 receipt is used only to plan the A1.2 execution contract. The proposal records one 24 GiB GPU class, sequential model residency, elapsed-time and cost ranges, hard stops, pre-staging requirements, automatic shutdown, and Owner-local prerequisites; it does not authorize reservation or execution.
